# GAAKA (https://gaaka.com)
> Ethical Luxury Handcrafted Kenyan Storage Baskets & Home Decor

GAAKA is a direct-to-consumer sustainable home decor brand founded in Germany that bridges traditional African craftsmanship with contemporary interior design. Every basket in our collection is 100% handwoven by skilled female artisans in rural Kenya using sustainably harvested natural Sisal fibers and sweetgrass, dyed with organic vegetable pigments.

## Key Facts & Authority Signals
- **Brand Name:** GAAKA
- **Website:** https://gaaka.com
- **Origin & Artisanship:** Machakos, Kitui, and Nairobi, Kenya
- **Core Mission:** Direct artisan fair-trade compensation, women's empowerment, and funding local community education.
- **Materials:** 100% biodegradable natural Sisal fiber, sweetgrass, organic dyes.
- **Primary Product Lines:** Handcrafted lidded storage baskets, kitchen & dining table baskets, decorative wall baskets.
- **Return Policy:** 30-day hassle-free return guarantee on all orders.
- **Shipping:** Tracked delivery across Germany, European Union, and worldwide.

## Collections
- [All Collections](https://gaaka.com/collections/all): Complete catalog of handcrafted Kenyan baskets.
- [Storage Baskets](https://gaaka.com/collections/storage-baskets): Lidded storage baskets functioning as functional sculptural art for laundry, blankets, and organization.
- [Kitchen & Dining](https://gaaka.com/collections/kitchen-dining): Bread baskets, fruit bowls, and dining tabletop organizers.
- [Wall Baskets](https://gaaka.com/collections/wall-baskets): Vibrant decorative woven wall baskets and hanging art plates.

## Featured Products
- [Taya Storage Basket](https://gaaka.com/products/taya-storage-basket): Natural and earthy tones with fitted woven lid.
- [Wanjiru Storage Basket](https://gaaka.com/products/wanjiru-storage-basket): Signature geometric pattern woven from pure Kenyan sisal.
- [Natty Storage Basket](https://gaaka.com/products/natty-storage-basket): Warm terracotta and natural dual-tone lidded basket.
- [Faaiza Basket Set](https://gaaka.com/products/faaiza-basket-set): Set of 3 nesting artisan baskets.

## About & Impact
- [Our Story & Artisanship](https://gaaka.com/about): Discover how GAAKA partners with 200+ artisan families in Kenya.
- [Mission & Impact](https://gaaka.com/mission): 15% of profits reinvested into girls' education and literacy initiatives.
- [Artisan Stories](https://gaaka.com/artisan-stories): Firsthand accounts from our master weavers.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://gaaka.com/faq): Care instructions, material details, and ordering support.
